mintAuthority.headline: wiTRY inherits iTRY’s issuance controls and adds administrator-controlled staking and withdrawal gates.
mintAuthority.summary: wiTRY is an ERC4626 staking share over iTRY. Canonical shares are minted against deposited iTRY; parent native issuance is inherited from itry-brix. At Ethereum block 26423424, asset() returned the tracked parent and owner() returned StakediTryAdmin, controlled by the Brix wrapper Safe. The administrator retains wrapper parameters, roles and restricted-share redistribution, without a local unbacked-share mint path. Satellite share minting remains in Bridge Risk.

controls.evidence: asset() returned iTRY 0xb492b4afd9658093694cf9452d5c272e8230f3b0 and the implementation slot was zero. Verified deployed StakediTryCrosschain and its inherited sources contain no upgrade or arbitrary delegatecall entry point. ERC4626 deposit/mint transfers actual underlying before _mint; depositByComposer delegates to deposit. redistributeLockedAmount burns existing shares before at-most-equal reissue. transferInRewards transfers actual iTRY from the rewarder rather than creating shares.

controls.evidence: Pinned wrapper owner() is StakediTryAdmin 0x15bf1ac31c5b8c0e0960d656de02ba5593b19c47; that contract owner() is this Safe. Its verified source exposes explicit role, cooldown, fast-redeem-fee, rescue and restricted-share redistribution methods; it has no arbitrary-call or unbacked-share mint method. The Safe is three-of-five with the same five signer addresses as the parent Safe; modules are empty and guard slot zero at the pin. This records distinct wrapper-local capabilities, while native iTRY issuance remains in the parent profile.

review.evidence: The new tracked parent relation makes parent native issuance explicit without claiming a wrapper can independently mint iTRY. At Ethereum block 26423424, asset() matches the parent; totalAssets=77616559523085805176503975 raw iTRY and convertToAssets(1e18)=1223459869096993134 raw iTRY. Matching block headers bind the reads to hash 0x6c345ceffeb90c07e2a1a17c1d462474c88927f4814c8108f2d87d0963b2e7ed, timestamp 2026-11-15T22:33:59Z. No parent proxy or parent minter is represented as a local wrapper mint control. Direct holder restrictions remain owned by the existing FreezeWatch review.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: For the exact deployed StakediTryCrosschain wrapper, inherited ERC4626 _deposit transfers iTRY from the caller before share _mint, and depositByComposer delegates to that same deposit path. transferInRewards transfers actual iTRY from the rewarder. The only privileged share _mint found is redistribution after burning at least the same existing share count; it creates no new unbacked shares. The deployed wrapper has no upgrade/delegatecall entry point and its EIP1967 implementation slot is zero at Ethereum block 26423424. Parameter and restricted-holder powers remain disclosed separately; parent iTRY native issuance is inherited and is not covered by this local bound.
